title: Moon-Moo

symbol.name: Moon-Moo
symbol.meaning: King Munmu of Silla · ITF pattern 21 of 24

note.p: Moon-Moo honours Munmu, the 30th king of Silla. By his wish his body was buried in the sea near Daewangam (the Great King's Rock), so that his soul might defend his land against the Japanese for ever; the Seokguram stone grotto is said to have been built to guard his tomb, and it is a fine example of Silla culture. The 61 movements stand for the last two figures of 661, the year he came to the throne. You start in parallel ready stance facing D: slow double side kicks, fingertip thrusts, reverse hooking kicks and jumps into X-stance to B and A; palm pressing blocks and slow high-and-low knife-hand blocks on one leg; slow back kicks; palm blocks, side front kicks, side fist strikes, scooping blocks, pushing kicks and reverse turning kicks along the C–D line; high twisting kicks and back fist strikes; sweeping, checking and thrusting kicks with knife-hand strikes; jumps into X-stance with low punches, a mid-air spinning kick, and an arc-hand block and high punch to finish.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (61 movements; the sweeping kick and guarding block in 49 and 52, and the checking and thrusting kicks in 50 and 53, are split into -1 and -2 here). The moves go back and forth through the centre of the + diagram, so the board shows them in order, read down the page in rows; the minimap shows roughly where each one is. Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; AC, AD and BD are diagonals. Finish by bringing the right foot back to parallel ready stance.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre facing D in parallel ready stance.
Turn the face to B into a right bending ready stance A, side-on to B, slowly.
Left high side piercing kick toward B, slowly.
Again, left high side piercing kick toward B, as a double kick.
Lower the left foot toward B into a sitting stance facing D. Right flat fingertip middle thrust toward D.
Right high reverse hooking kick toward B, slowly.
Land the right foot toward B with a jump, into a right X-stance facing C. Right knife-hand middle side strike toward B.
Move the left foot to A into a left walking stance facing A. Right palm pressing block.
Move the right foot to A into a right walking stance. Left palm pressing block.
Pull the left reverse footsword up to the right knee joint into a right one-leg stance facing D. Left knife-hand high side block toward B and right knife-hand low side block toward A, slowly.
Lower the left foot beside the right foot, then turn the face to A into a left bending ready stance A, side-on to A, slowly.
Right high side piercing kick toward A, slowly.
Again, right high side piercing kick toward A, as a double kick.
Lower the right foot toward A into a sitting stance facing D. Left flat fingertip middle thrust toward D.
Left high reverse hooking kick toward A, slowly.
Land the left foot toward A with a jump, into a left X-stance facing C. Left knife-hand middle side strike toward A.
Move the right foot to B into a right walking stance facing B. Left palm pressing block.
Move the left foot to B into a left walking stance. Right palm pressing block.
Pull the right reverse footsword up to the left knee joint into a left one-leg stance facing D. Right knife-hand high side block toward A and left knife-hand low side block toward B, slowly.
Turn the face to C, drawing the right foot up into a left bending ready stance B facing D.
Right high back piercing kick toward C, slowly.
Lower the right foot toward C into a left walking stance facing D. Right middle punch.
Turn the face to C, drawing the left foot up into a right bending ready stance B facing D.
Left high back piercing kick toward C, slowly.
Lower the left foot toward C into a right walking stance facing D. Left middle punch.
Slide toward C into a right rear foot stance facing D (left foot forward on its ball). Left palm downward block.
Left middle side front snap kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Lower the left foot toward D, then stamp the right foot toward C into a sitting stance facing A. Right side fist middle side strike toward C.
Slide toward C, keeping the sitting stance. Left palm scooping block.
In the same stance, right middle punch toward A, straight on from 28.
In the same stance, left knife-hand low side block toward D.
Step the left foot quickly just past the right foot: right middle side pushing kick toward C.
Lower the right foot toward C, then left high reverse turning kick toward C.
Lower the left foot toward C into a left walking stance facing C. Left knife-hand high side block.
Slide toward D into a left rear foot stance facing C (right foot forward on its ball). Right palm downward block.
Right middle side front snap kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Lower the right foot toward C, then stamp the left foot toward D into a sitting stance facing A. Left side fist middle side strike toward D.
Slide toward D, keeping the sitting stance. Right palm scooping block.
In the same stance, left middle punch toward A, straight on from 37.
In the same stance, right knife-hand low side block toward C.
Step the right foot quickly just past the left foot: left middle side pushing kick toward D.
Lower the left foot toward D, then right high reverse turning kick toward D.
Lower the right foot toward D into a right walking stance facing D. Right knife-hand high side block.
Move the left foot to D, then right high twisting kick toward AD.
Lower the right foot toward C into a left walking stance facing D. Right back fist side back strike toward C, the left fist extended toward D.
Shift back toward C, keeping the walking stance. Right back fist front strike toward D.
Move the right foot to D, then left high twisting kick toward BD.
Lower the left foot toward C into a right walking stance facing D. Left back fist side back strike toward C, the right fist extended toward D.
Shift back toward C, keeping the walking stance. Left back fist front strike toward D.
Left sweeping kick toward D with the side sole.
Lower the left foot toward D into a right L-stance (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Left side checking kick toward D.
Without setting the foot down, left middle side thrusting kick toward D, forming a forearm guarding block.
Lower the left foot toward D into a right L-stance (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left knife-hand middle outward strike.
Right sweeping kick toward D with the side sole.
Lower the right foot toward D into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Right side checking kick toward D.
Without setting the foot down, right middle side thrusting kick toward D, forming a forearm guarding block.
Lower the right foot toward D into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right knife-hand middle outward strike.
Move the right foot to C, then pivoting on the right foot turn counter-clockwise into a left walking stance facing C. Right middle punch.
Jump toward C, landing in a right X-stance facing AC. Left low punch toward C, the right fist brought to the left shoulder.
Jump toward D, landing in a left X-stance facing AD. Right low punch toward D, the left fist brought to the right shoulder.
Jump and spin clockwise: right mid-air spinning kick toward D.
Land toward D in a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Move the right foot to the side rear of the left foot, then the left foot to C, into a right walking stance facing D. Left arc-hand rising block.
In the same stance, right high punch.
